content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Operates paid-membership dating apps for individual adults seeking romantic partners, matching Match's core model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures and sells beauty and personal care products through retailers and salons, not dating software."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells mobile ad tech and app preloading to developers and carriers, not consumer dating services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Runs regulated online gambling and betting brands earning wager margins, not subscription dating apps."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer security and identity protection subscriptions and personal finance tools, not dating platforms."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Operates a subscription and advertising social app for LGBTQ users seeking dates, close to Match's dating model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Is a televised and online retailer of consumer goods, with no matchmaking or dating platform."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Runs content recommendation and native advertising for publishers and advertisers, not consumer dating."}]}
